fusions.name: Horns First
fusions.desc: A butt with the haft that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: King of the Mound
fusions.desc: Clears the ground around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throwing each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Heels Dug In
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Won't Be Shifted
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 3% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
